posts.title: Dispatches of a Trust Architect: When Intelligence Becomes a Permission
posts.description: After three decades of building internet infrastructure, I’ve learned that the most dangerous moment isn’t when a system fails, it’s when it succeeds and then inverts its purpose. This week confirmed that again. Anthropic abruptly disabled its frontier models Fable 5 and Mythos 5 for every customer, to comply with a U.S. government national-security order. posts.title: Musings of a Trust Architect: On Being the Fifteenth Standard
posts.description: Often, the first thing that I hear when I describe Gordian Envelope is that we already have too many credential formats. They’re right.
